_readme: The cafeteria menu boards' feature slot (CONTRACT Draft 11; cafe-menu.js 1.6.0) and MENU02's evening page (Draft 12; cafe-menu.js 1.7.0). An item shows ONLY when reviewStatus is "approved", today (New York) is inside its optional startsOn..endsOn (inclusive), its fields are well formed and no text names a time. Drafts ("draft", "review") and "retired" never show. Rotation, dwell and gap live in board.json menu.features (an id missing from its order never shows). Steps: work/cafe-menu/proof/enhance-1015/MAINTAIN.md.

items.title: Compliments to the Kitchen
lines: Enjoyed your meal? Let our kitchen team know—a kind word goes a long way.
When you receive a survey, share your dining experience: what you enjoyed and what could be better.

items.title: Coming this week
items._note: Built from menu.json: each upcoming printed day's dinner (its featured dish, the board's display name), skipping today; never past validThrough (Nov 8, 2026); a meal with its own correction notice is skipped; hides when no future printed day remains.

MENU02 only (its board.json order): in the evening (after dinner, before the night screen) the board alternates tomorrow's day (tomorrowMin minutes) with THE WEEK AHEAD (weekMin minutes): the next 7 printed days from tomorrow, each with its lunch and dinner main dishes from menu.json (featured first, at most two, the printed name exactly). Hides when fewer than 3 days remain (from Nov 6 with the current menu).

items.title: Daily reflection
items._note: One quote a day from menu/reflections.json (text + author; the source stays in the file), the same on both TVs. Tevin approved the feature and the 30 quotes on 2026-10-18 (list: work/cafe-menu/content-1015/REFLECTIONS-REVIEW.md). To strike a quote, set its "reviewStatus": "retired" in reflections.json.

items.title: Healthy habits
items._note: One tip a day from menu/good-to-know.json, ONLY among the tips Dietary approved there (reviewStatus approved + reviewedBy + reviewedOn). Every tip ships pending, so this card shows nothing until Dietary signs off.

items.title: Food facts
items._note: One fact a day from menu/good-to-know.json, ONLY among the facts Dietary approved there; the question first, the answer after revealAfterSec seconds (with its reveal sentence only where the strip has room for the full card; elsewhere the answer closes the question's line). Every fact ships pending, so this card shows nothing until Dietary signs off.
